saw_lines: Fans buy a club, not a product. They return on match day for the scarf, the shirt and the season ticket.
So the sale is won at first visit, when a new fan on the shop page must pick one item.
Your paid creative is one Google image from August 2025, so fans see one ad. Shoot two images, a scarf and a season pass, and run them on Google and Meta.
ads_1: Match day scarf and season pass creative, built around the next home game
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter and YouTube
